names: Mono- and diacetyl tartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
display_name: E472e (Mono- and diacetyl tartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids)

more_info.overview: Mono- and diacetyl tartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include bread prepared solely with the following ingredients: wheat flour, water, yeast or leaven,  salt. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: A mixture of glycerol esters containing mono- and diacetyltartaric acid and fatty acids from food fats or oils. The specification does not establish a single animal or plant source for the fatty-acid component.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
